mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the core CPI index exceeds 295.0, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank tightening, causing a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 295.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative sentiment shift in equity markets, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not lead to negative 20-day SPX returns in at least 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), the labor market is tight, leading to wage pressures and inflation, which prompts the Fed to tighten policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which leads to immediate negative sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% indicates a strong economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.5%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly payroll growth falls below 0.5% year-over-year, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth < 0.5% YoY.
